description: This grouped bar chart illustrates the effect of various multilingual BERT models across different linguistic tags. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled "tag", and displays four groups in the following order: "case", "gender", "number", and "tense". The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "effect", using a linear scale with a visible range from 0 to 20 and a regular tick label interval of 5, accompanied by horizontal grid lines. Within each tag category, there is a group of six bars representing different models, distinguished by color according to the legend: mBERT-L2 (light blue-grey), XLM-L2 (dark blue-grey), mBERT-R2 (light olive green), XLM-R2 (dark olive green), mBERT-B2 (light reddish-brown), and XLM-B2 (dark reddish-brown). The bars are not sorted by height across the chart. The "case" category contains the tallest bars overall, with mBERT-B2 reaching approximately 12.2 and XLM-B2 at roughly 11.2. In contrast, the "tense" category contains the shortest bars, with values for models like XLM-L2 and mBERT-R2 falling near zero. Visually, every bar is outlined and features a prominent vertical error bar extending above and below its top edge, and the entire chart is set against a dark grey background.
